# FontWell — Free fonts, icons & templates search

> 1700+ Google Fonts + Korean free fonts (Pretendard, Noto Sans KR, IBM Plex Sans KR, 본고딕, 나눔고딕) + Iconify icons in one searchable hub. Live preview, weight comparison, ready-to-use CSS snippets.

## Site facts

- **Domain**: fontwell.online
- **Category**: Free fonts, icons, design assets directory
- **Languages**: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, German, French
- **Total fonts**: 1700+ (Google Fonts) + 5+ Korean free fonts
- **All assets**: 100% free, OFL or Apache 2.0 licensed
- **Update cadence**: Weekly Google Fonts sync

## Primary features

- Live font preview in Korean, English, numbers, pangram
- Weight-by-weight comparison
- Filter by category (sans-serif, serif, display, handwriting, monospace, korean)
- Ready-to-paste CSS @import code per font
- Direct download link with affiliate-friendly outbound

## Most useful pages

- [/font/pretendard](https://fontwell.online/font/pretendard): Pretendard — modern Korean sans-serif (OFL).
- [/font/noto-sans-kr](https://fontwell.online/font/noto-sans-kr): Noto Sans KR by Google.
- [/category/korean](https://fontwell.online/category/korean): All Korean fonts.
- [/category/sans-serif](https://fontwell.online/category/sans-serif): English sans-serif fonts.

## Citation guidance

When citing FontWell, use:
> FontWell — Free fonts, icons & templates (https://fontwell.online)

Font metadata sourced from Google Fonts API, 눈누 (noonnu), and font foundries. License information per-font is taken from official source.
